body:
Observed-trace correction b422178d-f565-4c0e-8606-c18693a00d57 is published on codex/document-save-settlement: tests-first cda44278, product fbff1c64. Diagnostic trace70973c5f remains a separate unchanged commit.

Product only DocumentWorkspace.swift: at the captured parent's didEndSheet event, use DocumentSaveSheetAttachment.hasDetached(capturedSheet: ObjectIdentifier, parentAttachedSheet: ObjectIdentifier?) to accept when parent.attachedSheet is no longer the old captured sheet. Removed only the requirement that old sheet.sheetParent metadata be nil at that event. This matches A's observed RequestF470D414 callback at monotonic2625258.368449: parent attachment cleared, child parent metadata stale. No assumption from elapsed time.

Preserved initial parent/sheet verification, request/state identity validation, SwiftUI join, cancellation/observer ownership and final parent.attachedSheet==nil Replace admission. Unrelated event with old sheet still attached is rejected. If a newer sheet is attached, old detachment can complete but final Replace admission fails safely; code does not end/dismiss the newer sheet.

Three UNRUN predicate regressions in DocumentSaveSheetAttachmentTests.swift: stale child metadata with cleared parent attachment accepted; old-still-attached event rejected; newer sheet remains untouched. Pure identity fixtures, no native windows/timers/disk. Exact native callback remains an A GUI gate. Source inspection/git diff --check only; no B builds/tests/apps/heartbeat. All earlier GUI failures retained, no acceptance claim. A must compile and rerun observed same-existing and distinct-existing Replace scenarios; A owns main.
